sql.query: INSERT INTO tbl_contract_clauses (tenantId,clauseName,clauseCode,clauseCategory,clauseHtml,clauseBehaviour,conditionKey,sortOrder,isActive,createdByUserId,modifiedByUserId) SELECT :tenantId,:name,NULLIF(TRIM(:code),''),NULLIF(TRIM(:category),''),:html,:behaviour,NULLIF(TRIM(:conditionKey),''),:sortOrder,:isActive,:userId,:userId2 FROM DUAL WHERE :id=0 AND NULLIF(TRIM(:name2),'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(:html2),'') IS NOT NULL AND :behaviour2 IN ('mandatory','optional','conditional') AND (:behaviour3<>'conditional' OR NULLIF(TRIM(:conditionKey2),'') IS NOT NULL) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=r.id INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='agreements.configure' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:roleUser AND utr.tenantId=:tenantId2 AND utr.isActive=1)

UPDATE tbl_contract_clauses c SET c.clauseName=:name,c.clauseCode=NULLIF(TRIM(:code),''),c.clauseCategory=NULLIF(TRIM(:category),''),c.clauseHtml=:html,c.clauseBehaviour=:behaviour,c.conditionKey=CASE WHEN :behaviour2='conditional' THEN NULLIF(TRIM(:conditionKey),'') ELSE NULL END,c.sortOrder=:sortOrder,c.isActive=:isActive,c.modifiedByUserId=:userId WHERE c.id=:id AND c.tenantId=:tenantId AND :behaviour3 IN ('mandatory','optional','conditional') AND NULLIF(TRIM(:name2),'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(:html2),'') IS NOT NULL AND (:behaviour4<>'conditional' OR NULLIF(TRIM(:conditionKey2),'') IS NOT NULL) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=r.id INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='agreements.configure' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:roleUser AND utr.tenantId=c.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1)
